_comment: Derived from vantom_banshee_blue, whose printed functional text is byte-identical. Colour variants differ only in {p} and pitch, and both come from card data rather than this file, so the abilities carry over unchanged. Verified against the corpus as its own card. INHERITED NOTE FROM vantom_banshee_blue: Had NO abilities at all. Rune Gate (CR 8.3.27) is implemented as a DECLARED static -- play.rune_gate_available reads it off the CardDef -- so a card that prints the keyword but declares nothing gets no permission and the keyword does nothing. Blood Debt is a printed keyword read from card data, which is why this card looked complete.
